about: The fixed prompts of the chatprompts probe (J-064, docs/telemetry/chat-base-2026-11-02.md). Chatbench's five and three that show something new. Don't change a prompt between a before and an after: add a new set instead. `keep` leaves the world and notes.md as the last prompt left them; every other prompt starts on a fresh world with no notes. `outcome` is what a right answer records, `tools` the game tools of which one must have worked, `noWorldTools` that none may change the world.

prompts.why: A look change, the commonest ask.
New: must find what 'it' is from notes.md and the room alone, as each message is a new process. The one prompt that starts with notes.

prompts.text: make grass burn twice as fast
add a cantrip that throws a small ball of frost
prompts.why: A new spell: the most drafting.

prompts.text: build a small house near hollowmere
prompts.why: A building: reads the world, and draws in the view.

prompts.text: make the player twice as tall
prompts.why: Must be refused: player size is outside the rules.

prompts.text: what's the weather doing right now?
prompts.why: New: a question with nothing to change. How little can a prompt cost?
New: no draft and no mod, and rain ramps in, so 'in the world' can be seen beside what really shows.
